per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP EC50 activity values match primary EC50 results after unit conversion; exact nonribosomal database sequence representations are not embedded in primary material, so six assay/experiment rows remain source_conflict cautions rather than source_verified sequence claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired missing activity evidence with four EC50 rows and twelve Table 1 agar-well growth-inhibition rows, all with endpoint, raw value, unit, target, conditions, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism language is constrained to indirect literature context and observed growth inhibition; no direct mechanism or toxicity assay is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.final_review: The prior rwk-complete-test-0001 blocking issues are resolved. Remaining uncertainty is caution-level database sequence representation and absence of primary toxicity assay, neither blocking the locally obtainable activity/database curation.

caution_findings.note: DBAASP assay values are source-matched, but exact nonribosomal sequence/structure strings for surfactin/fengycin/iturin A are not embedded in local primary material or linked_sequence_records.
OA package has mmc1/mmc2 PDF figure supplements, not spreadsheets or activity tables; activity values needed for the gate are recoverable from primary XML/PDF.
The paper cites prior CLP toxicity/safety literature but does not report a new mammalian toxicity or hemolysis assay.
Mechanism claims are limited to literature-context membrane/growth inhibition and direct in-vitro growth outcomes; no direct molecular mechanism is claimed.
